answer.summary: No prior evidence supports superior memory management through temporal or contextual continuity in stable input conditions without predefined features or feature extraction mechanisms.
answer.content: The analysis of Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 confirms the absence of explicit, non-feature-based mechanisms for temporal continuity, state interpolation, or emergent contextual coherence under stable input. All prior queries have yielded negative results, indicating a gap in reported memory dynamics beyond surface-level skill retention or static feature storage. The focus must now shift to a more direct and observable form of persistence without relying on external structure or inference.
